name: Common Cold
description: A viral infection affecting the upper respiratory tract, commonly causing nasal and throat symptoms.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have sneezing and runny nose?
Is your cough mild?

doctorAdvice: Usually improves with rest and supportive care. Seek medical advice if symptoms become severe.

name: Influenza (Flu)
description: A viral respiratory infection causing fever, body pain, cough and weakness.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have high fever with body pain?
Did symptoms appear suddenly?

doctorAdvice: Rest, hydration and medical consultation are recommended if symptoms worsen.

name: COVID-19
description: A viral respiratory disease caused by coronavirus infection.

followUpQuestions.question: Have you experienced loss of smell or taste?
Do you have dry cough?

doctorAdvice: Follow medical guidelines and consult healthcare professionals when required.

name: Migraine
description: A neurological condition causing intense headache episodes with sensory sensitivity.

followUpQuestions.question: Does light make your headache worse?
Does sound increase discomfort?

doctorAdvice: Recurring or severe headaches should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.

name: Tension Headache
description: A common headache caused by stress, muscle tension or fatigue.

followUpQuestions.question: Does the headache feel like pressure around the head?

doctorAdvice: Managing stress, rest and proper hydration may help. Consult a doctor for persistent headaches.

name: Acute Gastroenteritis
description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestine commonly caused by viral infections or contaminated food.

followUpQuestions.question: Are you experiencing diarrhea?
Did vomiting start suddenly?

doctorAdvice: Maintain hydration and seek medical attention if dehydration or severe symptoms occur.

name: Food Poisoning
description: Illness caused by consuming contaminated food containing harmful microorganisms or toxins.

followUpQuestions.question: Did symptoms begin after eating suspicious food?
Are you having loose stools?

doctorAdvice: Drink fluids and seek medical help if symptoms are severe or prolonged.

name: Viral Fever
description: A fever caused by a viral infection that affects the body's immune response.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have fever?
Do you have body pain?

doctorAdvice: Rest, hydration and monitoring symptoms are recommended.

name: Typhoid
description: A bacterial infection caused by Salmonella bacteria, usually spread through contaminated food and water.

followUpQuestions.question: Has fever continued for several days?
Do you have abdominal discomfort?

doctorAdvice: Medical diagnosis and appropriate antibiotics may be required.

name: Dengue Fever
description: A mosquito-borne viral infection that can cause high fever and severe body pain.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have very high fever?
Do you have severe body or joint pain?
Do you have skin rash?

doctorAdvice: Medical evaluation is important, especially if fever is high or warning signs appear.

name: Malaria
description: A mosquito-borne parasitic infection causing fever episodes, chills and weakness.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you experience fever with chills?
Does fever come in repeated episodes?

doctorAdvice: Medical testing is recommended because malaria requires proper diagnosis and treatment.

name: Chickenpox
description: A viral infection causing an itchy skin rash with fluid-filled blisters.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have itchy fluid-filled blisters?
Did the rash appear gradually?

doctorAdvice: Avoid scratching and consult a doctor if symptoms become severe.

name: Measles
description: A viral infection causing fever, cough, and characteristic skin rash.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have red or watery eyes?
Do you have fever with rash?

doctorAdvice: Medical evaluation is recommended, especially in children or severe cases.

name: Mumps
description: A viral infection affecting salivary glands, causing swelling near the jaw.

followUpQuestions.question: Is there swelling near your jaw or cheeks?
Does chewing cause pain?

doctorAdvice: Consult a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis.

name: Conjunctivitis
description: An inflammation or infection of the eye's outer membrane.

followUpQuestions.question: Are your eyes red and irritated?
Is there discharge from the eye?

doctorAdvice: Avoid touching eyes and seek medical advice if symptoms worsen.

name: Sinusitis
description: Inflammation of the sinus cavities causing facial pressure, congestion and nasal symptoms.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you feel pressure or pain around your face?
Is your nose blocked with thick mucus?

doctorAdvice: Consult a doctor if symptoms persist or become severe.

name: Pharyngitis
description: Inflammation of the throat commonly causing sore throat and difficulty swallowing.

followUpQuestions.question: Does swallowing cause throat pain?
Is throat irritation your main symptom?

doctorAdvice: Stay hydrated and seek medical advice if symptoms become severe.

name: Tonsillitis
description: Inflammation of tonsils causing throat pain, swelling and fever.

followUpQuestions.question: Are your tonsils swollen?
Do you have difficulty swallowing?

doctorAdvice: Medical examination may be required for severe throat infections.

name: Bronchitis
description: Inflammation of bronchial tubes causing persistent cough and breathing discomfort.

followUpQuestions.question: Have you had a cough for several days?
Are you coughing mucus?

doctorAdvice: Consult a healthcare professional if breathing problems increase.

name: Pneumonia
description: A serious lung infection affecting air sacs and causing breathing difficulty.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you experience difficulty breathing?
Does breathing cause chest pain?

doctorAdvice: Medical evaluation is important because pneumonia can become serious.

name: Asthma
description: A chronic respiratory condition causing narrowing of airways and difficulty breathing.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you experience wheezing while breathing?
Does cold air or exercise trigger breathing difficulty?

doctorAdvice: Asthma symptoms should be monitored and managed with proper medical guidance.

name: Tuberculosis
description: A bacterial infection mainly affecting the lungs and causing long-term respiratory symptoms.

followUpQuestions.question: Has your cough continued for many weeks?
Do you experience night sweats or unexplained weight loss?

doctorAdvice: Medical testing and professional treatment are required.

name: Allergic Rhinitis
description: An allergic reaction affecting the nose, commonly triggered by dust, pollen or allergens.

followUpQuestions.question: Do symptoms worsen around dust or pollen?
Do you have frequent sneezing attacks?

doctorAdvice: Avoid known allergens and seek medical advice for persistent symptoms.

name: Skin Allergy
description: An allergic reaction of the skin causing irritation, itching and redness.

followUpQuestions.question: Did itching start after contact with something new?
Is the affected area red or swollen?

doctorAdvice: Avoid possible allergens and consult a doctor if symptoms worsen.

name: Eczema
description: A chronic skin condition causing dry, itchy and inflamed skin.

followUpQuestions.question: Is your skin dry and repeatedly itchy?
Does the rash return repeatedly?

doctorAdvice: Skin care and medical guidance may help control symptoms.

name: Psoriasis
description: A chronic autoimmune skin condition causing rapid skin cell buildup and thick scaly patches.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have thick, scaly patches on your skin?
Do the skin patches return repeatedly?

doctorAdvice: Psoriasis requires proper skin care and medical guidance for long-term control.

name: Acne
description: A common skin condition caused by blocked pores and increased oil production.

followUpQuestions.question: Are there pimples or blackheads on your skin?
Is the affected area oily?

doctorAdvice: Maintain proper skin hygiene and seek medical advice for severe acne.

name: Urinary Tract Infection
description: An infection affecting parts of the urinary system, commonly the bladder.

followUpQuestions.question: Does urination cause burning or pain?
Are you urinating more frequently than usual?

doctorAdvice: Medical evaluation may be required, especially if fever or pain increases.

name: Kidney Stone
description: A condition where hard mineral deposits form inside the kidney or urinary tract.

followUpQuestions.question: Is the pain severe and located near your side/back?
Have you noticed blood in urine?

doctorAdvice: Severe pain or urinary problems require medical evaluation.

name: Appendicitis
description: Inflammation of the appendix causing abdominal pain and digestive symptoms.

followUpQuestions.question: Is the pain mainly on the lower right side of your abdomen?
Did the pain increase over time?

doctorAdvice: Appendicitis can require urgent medical attention.

name: Peptic Ulcer
description: A sore that develops in the lining of the stomach or small intestine.

followUpQuestions.question: Is there a burning pain in your upper abdomen?
Does pain occur when your stomach is empty?

doctorAdvice: Persistent stomach pain should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.

name: GERD (Acid Reflux)
description: A condition where stomach acid flows back into the food pipe causing irritation.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you feel burning sensation rising from your stomach to chest?
Does it worsen after meals?

doctorAdvice: Lifestyle changes and medical guidance can help manage symptoms.

name: Constipation
description: A digestive condition causing difficulty or reduced frequency of bowel movements.

followUpQuestions.question: Have you had difficulty passing stool?
Are stools harder than usual?

doctorAdvice: Increase hydration and consult a doctor if symptoms persist.

name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
description: A chronic digestive disorder affecting bowel habits and causing abdominal discomfort.

followUpQuestions.question: Do symptoms repeatedly come and go?
Do you experience alternating constipation and diarrhea?

doctorAdvice: Diet management and medical consultation may help control symptoms.

name: Diabetes Mellitus
description: A chronic condition where blood glucose levels remain elevated due to insulin problems.

followUpQuestions.question: Are you unusually thirsty frequently?
Do you urinate more often than normal?

doctorAdvice: Blood sugar testing and medical supervision are important.

name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
description: A condition where blood pressure remains higher than normal over time.

followUpQuestions.question: Have you been diagnosed with high blood pressure before?
Do you experience dizziness or blurred vision?

doctorAdvice: Regular monitoring and medical guidance are important.

name: Thyroid Disorder (Hypothyroidism)
description: A condition where the thyroid gland produces insufficient thyroid hormones.

followUpQuestions.question: Have you gained weight without major lifestyle changes?
Do you often feel unusually tired?

doctorAdvice: Blood tests and medical evaluation are needed for diagnosis.

name: Anemia
description: A condition where the body has reduced healthy red blood cells or hemoglobin.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you often feel tired even after resting?
Have you been told your hemoglobin is low?

doctorAdvice: Blood tests are required to confirm anemia.

name: Vitamin D Deficiency
description: A condition caused by insufficient vitamin D levels affecting bones and muscles.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have bone or muscle pain?
Do you spend very little time in sunlight?

doctorAdvice: Vitamin levels should be checked before supplementation.

name: Cluster Headache
description: A neurological headache disorder causing repeated severe attacks, often around one eye.

followUpQuestions.question: Is the headache mainly around one eye?
Does the headache occur in repeated attacks?

doctorAdvice: Severe recurring headaches should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.

name: Heart Attack (Myocardial Infarction)
description: A medical emergency caused by reduced blood flow to the heart muscle.

followUpQuestions.question: Is there severe pressure or pain in your chest?
Does pain spread to your arm, neck or jaw?

doctorAdvice: Seek emergency medical help immediately if warning signs appear.

name: Stroke
description: A condition where blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted.

followUpQuestions.question: Did weakness or speech problems start suddenly?
Is one side of the body weak?

doctorAdvice: Stroke symptoms require immediate emergency medical attention.

name: Epilepsy
description: A neurological disorder causing repeated seizures due to abnormal brain activity.

followUpQuestions.question: Have you experienced seizures or fits?
Do you lose awareness during episodes?

doctorAdvice: Neurological evaluation is recommended for repeated episodes.

name: Kidney Infection
description: A bacterial infection affecting the kidneys, often developing from urinary infections.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you have pain in your back or side?
Do you have fever along with urinary symptoms?

doctorAdvice: Medical treatment is important to prevent complications.

name: Gallstones
description: Hard deposits formed in the gallbladder that may cause abdominal pain.

followUpQuestions.question: Does pain occur after eating oily or fatty food?
Is pain located on the upper right side of abdomen?

doctorAdvice: Consult a doctor if pain is severe or repeated.

name: Hepatitis
description: Inflammation of the liver commonly caused by viral infections or other factors affecting liver function.

followUpQuestions.question: Have your eyes or skin become yellow?
Have you noticed dark urine?

doctorAdvice: Liver-related symptoms require medical evaluation and appropriate testing.

name: Arthritis
description: A condition causing inflammation and pain in joints.

followUpQuestions.question: Are your joints swollen or painful?
Is stiffness worse after waking up?

doctorAdvice: Persistent joint problems should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.

name: Osteoporosis
description: A condition where bones become weaker and more prone to fractures.

followUpQuestions.question: Have you experienced repeated bone fractures?
Have you been diagnosed with low bone density?

doctorAdvice: Bone health assessment and medical advice are recommended.

name: Depression
description: A mental health condition affecting mood, thoughts and daily activities.

followUpQuestions.question: Have you felt persistently sad for a long time?
Have you lost interest in activities you usually enjoy?

doctorAdvice: Mental health concerns should be discussed with a qualified professional.

name: Anxiety Disorder
description: A condition involving excessive worry, fear and physical stress responses.

followUpQuestions.question: Do you experience excessive fear or worry frequently?
Do you experience sudden panic feelings?

doctorAdvice: Mental health support and professional guidance can help manage symptoms.
